meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计直观可扩展的接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: 装上后,当设计或评审 API 时,Claude 会依据 REST 与 GraphQL 设计原则给出建议:资源命名与 HTTP 方法的选择、API 版本策略,并提醒注意最佳实践与常见坑。
howto.when: 当你要设计新 API、评审 API 规范或制定 API 设计标准时,该技能会触发。

say.text: 帮我按 REST 最佳实践设计一个用户管理的 API。
say.note: Claude 会给出资源命名、HTTP 方法和版本策略建议。

say.text: 评审一下这份 API 规范,指出不符合规范的地方。
为我的团队制定一套 GraphQL API 设计标准。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude applies REST and GraphQL design principles when designing or reviewing APIs, recommending resource naming, HTTP methods, versioning, and best practices while flagging common pitfalls.
howto.when_en: Activates when you are designing a new API, reviewing an API specification, or establishing API design standards.

say_en.text: Design a user-management REST API following best practices.
say_en.note: Claude suggests naming, HTTP methods, and versioning.

say_en.text: Review this API spec and flag non-compliant parts.
say_en.note: Claude checks it against REST and GraphQL rules.

say_en.text: Draft a set of GraphQL API design standards for my team.
say_en.note: Claude produces schema-first principles and conventions.
